description: ChatHLS pragma_bug_database.pdf → pragma/compile bug skill overlay. Source: test-chathls/ChatHLS-ACL-26/src/knowledge_repo/pragma_bug_database.pdf. Use for compile/csynth pragma placement and include/type failures.

skills.pattern: Compile/csynth failures from missing headers, undeclared identifiers, ignored pragmas, loop-label/pragma placement, or PIPELINE/UNROLL conflicts (ChatHLS pragma_bug_database)
skills.strategy: Route to one pragma-bug class: HFM=missing #include; UUI=undeclared identifier; TMB=type mismatch; UNP=unknown/ignored HLS pragma; MLL=misplaced loop label; URM=misplaced UNROLL; PUC=PIPELINE&UNROLL conflict. Fix the structural issue first (includes/types/labels) before adding more optimization pragmas.
required_steps: read the first hard ERROR lines (207-xxxx / undeclared / unknown type / ignored pragma)
map to HFM|UUI|TMB|UNP|MLL|URM|PUC
apply the matching chathls-pragma-* skill with minimal diff
recompile / csim / csynth to confirm
guards: do not add optimization pragmas to paper over missing includes or bad types
PIPELINE on a parent with a remaining child loop is usually PUC/URM — fix placement, not II alone
skills.template: CLASSIFY → HFM|UUI|TMB|UNP|MLL|URM|PUC → apply matching skill → revalidate

skills.pattern: ChatHLS catalog error HFM (HFM(Head File Missing)). Related: see catalog. Trigger when synthesis/csim/cosim logs or code review match this class.
skills.strategy: HFM = missing header (#include). Add the required include for custom types (e.g. ap_fixed / project kernel.h / mobilenet.h) at the top of the kernel translation unit. Do not invent typedefs that diverge from the benchmark header.
required_steps: identify whether the failure matches error type HFM: HFM(Head File Missing)
compare the failing pragma/code pattern against the known bug and correct examples
apply the minimal fix for this error type only — do not mix with sibling error classes
re-run csim/csynth (and cosim when required) to confirm the class is cleared
guards: only apply HFM fixes when this error class is actually present
do not insert unrelated pragmas just because this error type exists in the catalog
keep functional semantics identical unless the catalog example requires a structural rewrite
